name: 道の駅 たちばな
desc: 福岡県八女市、国道3号沿いにある道の駅「たちばな」。自然豊かな農業の町に位置し、年間を通して新鮮な農産物が豊富に揃うのが最大の特徴です。特産品は、全国有数の生産量を誇るキウイフルーツをはじめ、春の味覚であるタケノコ、甘くて美味しいみかん、そして香り高い八女茶など。地元食材を使った手作りの惣菜やスイーツも大人気です。緑豊かな山々に囲まれ、四季折々の八女の旬を存分に味わえる魅力的なスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 3 in Yame City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Tachibana" is situated in a nature-rich agricultural town. Its greatest feature is the abundant availability of fresh produce year-round. Local specialties include kiwifruit, for which the area boasts some of the highest production in Japan, as well as spring bamboo shoots, sweet mandarin oranges (mikan), and fragrant Yame tea. Handmade deli items and sweets using local ingredients are also highly popular. Surrounded by lush green mountains, it is an attractive spot where you can fully savor the seasonal flavors of Yame.
